explanation: Retains the original normalized witnesses throughout later source and reporting construction. The same sorted lists and membership witnesses remain available after all writes outside their explicitly reserved regions.
theorem_title: Normalized source data survive writes beyond their allocation
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceFiniteData.Normalized.keep {μ ν : ℕ → ℤ} {av ae bv be cv ce tables rec vals g n bound : ℕ}
    {hg : 0 < g} {originalA originalB originalC A B C : List ℤ}
    {hsA : A.Pairwise (· < ·)} {hsB : B.Pairwise (· < ·)} {hsC : C.Pairwise (· < ·)} {r : ℤ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceFiniteData.Normalized μ av ae bv be cv ce tables rec vals g hg originalA originalB originalC A B C hsA hsB hsC r)
    (hk : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν bound)
    (hA : originalA.length ≤ n) (hB : originalB.length ≤ n) (hC : originalC.length ≤ n)
    (hav : av+n ≤ bound) (hae : ae+2+2*n ≤ bound)
    (hbv : bv+n ≤ bound) (hbe : be+2+2*n ≤ bound)
    (hcv : cv+n ≤ bound) (hce : ce+2+2*n ≤ bound)
    (htables : tables+_root_.ThreeSum.ColorBandBounds.count n g ≤ bound)
    (hrecords : rec+4*_root_.ThreeSum.ColorBandBounds.count n g ≤ bound)
    (hcatalog : _root_.ThreeSum.LightBandRawA.space vals (_root_.ThreeSum.ColorBandBounds.count n g) g ≤ bound) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceFiniteData.Normalized ν av ae bv be cv ce tables rec vals g hg originalA originalB originalC A B C hsA hsB hsC r := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let normalized strictly sorted lists $A,B,C$ and their original color-class lists be represented in memory $\mu$ by the normalized-source predicate, for positive band width $g$. Assume each original list has length at most $n$. If $\nu$ agrees with $\mu$ below $b$, and every value segment, endpoint header, owner table, four-cell owner record array, and packed raw-$A$ catalog satisfies the displayed end bound at $b$, then the same normalized-source predicate holds in $\nu$.

Retains the original normalized witnesses throughout later source and reporting construction. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
